verification.method: Per-game embeddability read from the official CrazyGames gameframe config (disableEmbedding flag) in the wrapper HTML of all slugs.
verification.scratch: Every Scratch ID probed against the official Scratch API · official /embed player
verification.poki: Every Poki slug HTTP-validated on poki.com (200) in October 2026; 16 dead slugs were pruned. Poki serves frame-ancestors https://*.poki.io, so all Poki titles are honest external links with official CDN thumbnails.
verification.providerNote: pf games load from the publisher own hosting with no CrazyGames ad/branding shell.
verification.slowNote: pg embeds may show a pre-game ad. Player shows loading hints and an official-site escape.
